description:
Product settlement is systematically under-reported. Measured on
00420_enum_take_drop_split: 3 `runtime_demand` settled events for a compile in
which >=237 distinct RuntimeDemand products settled. 98.7% invisible.

## Two silent paths

- `ProductMemo::finish_group` (`pull.rs:458`) inserts N-1 members into `produced`
  with no event; `ProductDriver::pull` emits only for `key` (`pull.rs:1974`).
- `ProductReadContext::publish_product` (`pull.rs:1671`) calls `memo.finish` with
  no telemetry at all. Callers: `jobs/runtime_demand.rs:482` (the demand cone's
  co-publication of every non-anchor member) and `jobs/artifact.rs:189`.

## Emit where membership exists

One settled event per settled member, from the layer that owns the settle --
`finish`, `finish_group`, `publish_product`. Carry generation and
changed-vs-reproduced, both already computed and discarded (`pull.rs:422`).
Group membership is known inside `finish_group` and nowhere downstream:
`into_dependencies` returns only `(ProductDependencies, bool)` (`pull.rs:1689`).

## Do NOT change the settled event's arity as the fix

`raw_event3` exists (`sink.rs:691`) and the borrows are available, BUT bus
dispatch is runtime variant-matched, not type-checked (`bus.rs:140`; the
downcast falls through to `else { return; }`). Changing
`(&ProductKey, &ProductValue)` to arity 3 would SILENTLY disable five existing
handlers including the JSONL projection itself (`jsonl.rs:205`), emptying the
product rows with no compile error. Any signature change here needs a test that
proves the handler still fires.

Current consumers to keep green: `jsonl.rs:205`, `transport_contract_test.rs:40`,
`drive_test.rs:5557`, `pull.rs:2038`, `jsonl_test.rs:350`.

## Also

- Allowlist `pull.product.cache_hit` / `reentered` (`pull.rs:1929`, `:1936`) --
  emitted today but not public, so the log cannot separate a cache hit from a
  settle. Add `displaced`.
- Add `pull.rs`, `product_drive.rs`, `jobs/runtime_demand.rs` to the
  `production_telemetry_boundaries_are_raw_and_allocation_free` scan list
  (`world_test.rs:13`). The product emit sites are currently unguarded; all
  three already pass the guard's checks.

## Red test

TDD 4: a recursive product group with distinct ProductKeys and generations --
every member observable, membership attributable.

## Feeds

fz-kdt.5 is reasoning about settle counts that are floors; see its comment.
title: Product causality: emit every settlement, with generation and group membership
